violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Milk gallon (47F) and milk gallon (49F) observed in 2 Dr UR. Unit observed with broken gasket and is constantly opened due to storage of pita bread dough.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. Milk removed from unit and moved to walk in cooler.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: Manufacturer containers for SPICES were observed reused for the storage of other spices. (Ex: Black pepper stored in a manufacturer container of paprika.)
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. EHS discussed container usage with PIC, please replace containers with durable food contact surfaces.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment Components, Adjusted per Manufacturer
violations.observation: The door gaskets of the following unit is damaged: 2 Dr UR unit door on left side. This unit is constantly opened due to pita dough storage.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment components such as doors, seals, hinges, fasteners, and kick plates shall be kept intact, tight, and adjusted in accordance with manufacturer's specifications. Please repair gasket on the unit.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: Raw meatballs observed stored over RTE vegetables and milk in 2 Dr UR
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. Meatballs moved to walk in cooler unit.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials are not properly labeled with a common name. Observed spray bottle of soap and water in kitchen without proper labeling.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. Spray container labeled with contents.

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold or hot holding equipment: 2 Dr prep unit
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. Please obtain an ambient thermometer for this unit.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: Gasket of 2 Dr UR unit observed in poor repair.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. New Gasket has been obtained but not yet installed.

violations.title: Food Contact Surface, 4 Hour Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed SCISSORS located at the COOKLINE USED TO TRIM KABOBS that are not being cleaned at least every 4 hours. Scissors observed accumulated with debris and stored in a container of ambient water.
violations.corrective_action: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils must be cleaned and sanitized at least every 4 hours to prevent contamination by bacterial growth. Scissors taken to sink to wash, rinse, and sanitize.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. CFM observed with expired certification.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. A follow up visit will be conducted to ensure a CFM is present.

violations.title: Cutting Board, When to Resurface or Discard
violations.observation: The cutting board(s) along the PITA STATION and the SALAD PREP are heavily scratched and scored. The food contact surface is no longer easily cleaned and sanitized due to condition.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces such as cutting blocks and boards that are subject to scratching and scoring shall be resurfaced if they can no longer be effectively cleaned and sanitized, or discarded if they are not capable of being resurfaced. Please replace cutting boards by the next inspection.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: under equipment at cookline and prep line observed with debris
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.
